description: A modern, ergonomic chair with a distinctive design. The seat and backrest are upholstered in a textured, olive-green fabric, forming a continuous, flowing shape. The chair rests on a single, sleek metallic pedestal that expands into a four-pronged base, providing stability and a futuristic aesthetic. The base has a polished, silver finish, reflecting the subtle lighting of the studio. The overall form of the chair suggests comfort and contemporary style, making it suitable for various professional or home environments.
